scale_selection: Reuse the previously declared USD 1000 and 1250 whole-share threshold pair and USD 10000 source reference. These three points are fixed before this fee sensitivity and are not chosen by returns.
variable_under_test: USD 1 hypothetical fixed fee per nonzero executed symbol-side ticket, in addition to the unchanged 10 bps executed notional charge
ticket_definition: Each nonzero buy or sell of one symbol at one execution open incurs exactly one USD 1 fixed fee, irrespective of share count. Zero fill incurs no fee. A sale fee reduces its two-session unsettled proceeds; a buy fee and bps charge must be funded by already settled spendable cash at that open.
funding_order: Unchanged Phase 4 v3 order: date-effective corporate actions, then sales to unsettled queue, then TQQQ, QQQM and BOXX whole-share buys, respecting dividend restrictions, member reserve and outer cash target. Fixed fees are paid once in the same account identity and cannot be financed from unsettled proceeds, receivables, collateral or the member reserve for other symbols.
known_at_and_window: Unchanged 2023-03-28 through 2024-12-31 seen-development window, full original warmup and provider-process-date delayed-recognition proxy.
comparison: For each principal and each of the enhanced and matched-defense paths, compare an independently recursive fixed-ticket-fee account against the exact SHA-bound zero-fixed-fee account at 10 bps. Report actual fills, costs, exposures, return, drawdown and recovery. Do not add a fee to an old NAV series.
failure_rule: An intended sale whose proceeds cannot cover both charges fails the research path. A buy is reduced to the maximum affordable nonnegative whole-share fill after reserving both charges, or has zero fill and zero charge. Never allow negative cash or pending proceeds. Unexpected accounting, identity or date mismatch fails the path.
interpretation_limit: USD 1 is a declared synthetic sensitivity, not a real broker tariff, personal fee, recommended policy, out-of-sample result or approval to change the frozen Phase 4 candidate. No ratio or fee grid search.
